name: Snow Days (decrease in days per year)
description:
Projected changes in the annual number of ‘snow days’ (in days per year) at 2040 and 2090, compared to 1986-2005 baseline. Fig 4-36, p.96. 
Changes in snow days have been estimated from the Regional Climate Model output. This was done by counting precipitation days where the mean temperature was below the freezing point.
